title: Robo's Paper-Spring Jumper
hook: Robo hovers with jet boots and jumps on space bosses. Make a paper Robo that really jumps!
steps: Tape the 2 strips together in an L shape.
Fold one strip over the other, back and forth, to make a spring.
Tape the ends and draw a face on top.
Squash it flat, then let go!
happens: Your paper Robo springs up off the table, like a jump in level 1!
why: Folded paper squeezes like a spring and pushes back when you let go.

title: Glitch Galaxy Upside-Down Water
hook: In Glitch Galaxy, gravity flips upside down! Can you flip water upside down without spilling a drop?
need: an index card or a piece of stiff paper
a sink or a big bowl
steps: Fill the cup to the very top with water.
Lay the card flat on top.
Hold the card on and flip the cup over the sink.
Slowly let go of the card!
happens: The card stays on and the water stays in!
why: The air outside pushes up on the card harder than the water pushes down.

title: Duke Googool's Gooey Oobleck
hook: Duke Googool's goo is runny AND hard. Make the same goo, and add green coloring!
steps: Put the cornstarch in the bowl.
!Pour in the water slowly while you stir.
Squeeze a handful hard!
Now open your hand and let it drip.
Tap the top fast with your finger.
happens: It feels hard when you squeeze or tap it, and runny when you let go!
why: The tiny cornstarch bits jam together when pushed hard, then slide apart when you are gentle.

title: Magnet Robo Test
hook: In Mega Morph, Robo turns into Magnet Robo! Find out what Magnet Robo could pick up.
steps: Guess which things will stick.
Touch the magnet to each thing.
Make a sticks pile and a no-stick pile.
Walk around and test the fridge and doors too!
happens: Some metal things stick, but not all of them!
why: Magnets pull on iron and steel, but not on most other things.

title: Inside the Screen
hook: Robo shrinks down and goes INSIDE the computer. Let's peek at the tiny lights a screen is made of!
steps: !Show a white picture on the screen.
!Put one tiny drop of water on the screen.
Look very closely through the drop.
!Wipe the screen dry when you are done.
happens: You can see tiny red, green and blue dots!
why: The water drop works like a magnifying glass, and screens make every color from red, green and blue lights.

title: The Phantom Coin
hook: Phantom Robo can vanish into thin air. Make a coin vanish too!
steps: Put the coin on the table.
Put the glass on top of the coin.
Look at the coin through the side of the glass.
!Fill the glass with water and put the plate on top.
Look through the side again!
happens: The coin disappears!
why: Water bends the light from the coin up and away, so it cannot reach your eyes from the side.

title: Glitch Factory Color Spinner
hook: Pieces of every world got mixed up in the Glitch Factory. Mix two colors into one with a spinner!
steps: Trace a circle and cut it out.
Color half red and half yellow.
!Poke the pencil through the middle.
Spin it like a top!
happens: The colors blend and look orange while it spins!
why: Your eyes cannot keep up with fast colors, so your brain mixes them together.

title: Ancient Shadow Clock
hook: Long ago, before clocks, people told time with shadows. Robo needs one in Ancient Time!
need: a sunny spot outside or by a window
steps: Stand the pencil up in a ball of play dough on the paper.
Put it in the sun.
Draw a line on the shadow and write the time.
Come back every hour and draw again.
happens: The shadow moves around like a clock hand!
why: The sun moves across the sky, so the shadow moves too.

title: Mini Max's Grow Ray
hook: Mini Max shrinks everyone, but you can make things look BIG again with one drop of water!
steps: Lay plastic wrap flat over the writing.
Put one drop of water on the wrap.
Look at the words through the drop.
Try a bigger drop!
happens: The letters under the drop look bigger, like a GROW pad!
why: The round water drop bends light like a magnifying glass.

title: Flip Robo's Gravity Drop
hook: Flip Robo controls gravity! Test gravity yourself with a book and a sheet of paper.
need: a sheet of paper smaller than the book
steps: Drop the book and the flat paper at the same time. Which lands first?
Now lay the paper on top of the book.
Drop them together.
happens: On top of the book, the paper falls just as fast as the book!
why: Gravity pulls everything down the same, but air pushes on flat paper. The book blocks the air.

title: Glitch Teleport Arrow
hook: Glitch Robo makes things teleport and flip. Make an arrow flip with only water!
steps: Draw an arrow pointing right on the paper.
Hold the paper behind the empty glass.
!Fill the glass with water.
Look through the glass at the arrow again.
happens: The arrow flips and points the other way!
why: The round glass of water bends the light and flips the picture, like a lens.

title: Nobody Can Copy You
hook: Nega-Robo copies everyone's powers, but there is one thing nobody can copy: your fingerprints!
need: a magnifying glass (if you have one)
steps: Scribble a dark pencil patch on paper.
Rub your fingertip on the patch.
Press a piece of tape on your fingertip, then stick it on white paper.
Do one for everyone in your family and compare!
happens: Everyone's fingerprint has different swirls and lines!
why: Nobody in the world has the same fingerprints as you. That is why detectives use them.

title: Dusty's Dust-Cloud Magnet
hook: In the Bot Galaxy, Dusty sweeps away dust clouds. Make a balloon that pulls up dust like Dusty!
need: your hair or a wool sweater
steps: !Blow up the balloon and tie it.
Tear paper into tiny bits on the table.
Rub the balloon on your hair 10 times.
Hold the balloon just above the paper bits.
happens: The paper bits jump up and stick to the balloon, like Dusty sweeping up a dust cloud!
why: Rubbing gives the balloon a tiny static charge that pulls light things toward it.

title: Make Your Own Eclipse
hook: The sun and moon got stuck in Eclipse! Use a flashlight and a ball to see how the Moon changes.
steps: !Turn off the lights and put the flashlight on a table. That is the Sun!
Hold the ball out in front of you. That is the Moon.
Turn around slowly and watch the bright part grow and shrink.
Now hold the ball right between the flashlight and your eyes.
happens: The Moon changes shape, and when it is right in front of the Sun, it blocks the light like an eclipse!
why: The Sun always lights half of the Moon, and we see a different amount of that half as it goes around us.

title: Fused Crystal Garden
hook: Fused bosses are made of light blue and pink crystal power. Grow real crystals, and paint some blue and pink!
steps: !Stir lots of salt into the warm tap water until no more will melt.
Paint the salty water all over the black paper.
Put it on a plate in a sunny place.
Check it tomorrow!
happens: Tiny white sparkly crystals cover the paper!
why: The water dries up into the air, but the salt stays behind and makes crystals.

title: Star-Struck Ceiling
hook: Star meteors smashed 12 worlds! Rescue the mini stars by shining them on your ceiling.
steps: Draw dots on the paper in a star shape, like the Big Dipper.
!Poke a hole through each dot with the pencil.
Wrap the paper over the end of the flashlight and tape it.
Turn off the lights and shine it on the ceiling!
happens: Little stars shine on the ceiling!
why: Light only comes through the holes, so you see tiny bright dots like stars.

title: Musical Robo's Water Glass Song
hook: Musical Robo borrowed every song! Make music notes with glasses of water to bring a song back.
steps: !Line up the glasses on a table.
Fill them with different amounts of water: a little, more, more, and lots.
Tap each glass gently with the spoon.
Play them from low to high!
happens: Each glass sings a different note!
why: More water makes the glass shake slower, which makes a lower note.

title: Element Mix: Ice and Salt
hook: King Element Robo mixes elements. Mix water, ice and salt and see what happens!
steps: Put one ice cube on each plate.
Sprinkle salt on the first cube.
Sprinkle sugar on the second cube.
Leave the third cube plain.
Check every 5 minutes. Which one is melting fastest?
happens: The salty ice cube melts the fastest!
why: Salt mixes with the water on the ice and makes it harder for the water to stay frozen.

title: Time Portal Pendulum
hook: A Time Portal zaps Robo back in time! Build a swinging timer and count the ticks.
steps: Tie the key to the string.
Tape the string to the table so the key can swing.
Swing it and count the swings for 10 seconds.
Make the string shorter and count again.
happens: The short string swings faster!
why: A shorter swing has less far to go, so it goes back and forth more quickly.

title: Chain Swing Timer
hook: In Robo Jump 8, Robo swings on chains to free every game. Make your own swing and time it!
steps: Tie the key to the string.
Tape the string to the table so the key can swing.
Swing it and count the swings for 10 seconds.
Make the string shorter and count again.
happens: The short string swings faster, just like a quick chain swing!
why: A shorter swing has less far to go, so it goes back and forth more quickly.

title: See in 3D Like Robo
hook: Robo jumps in REAL 3D! Your two eyes are how you see in 3D too.
need: just your thumb and your eyes
steps: Hold your thumb up far in front of you.
Close your left eye and look at your thumb.
Now switch: open the left and close the right.
Switch back and forth fast!
happens: Your thumb jumps from side to side!
why: Each eye sees from a different spot, and your brain mixes the two pictures to see in 3D.

title: Spaghetti Tower
hook: Build the tallest tower in Robo Builder!
steps: Poke spaghetti into marshmallows to make triangles.
Join the triangles to build up.
Make it as tall as you can!
Measure it, then try to beat it.
happens: Towers made of triangles stand tall and strong!
why: Triangles do not bend out of shape when you push on them, so they make strong buildings.

hook: What sticks to a magnet? Hunt like a robot from Robo Escape!
steps: Guess which things will stick.
Touch the magnet to each thing.
Make a sticks pile and a no-stick pile.
Walk around and test the fridge and doors too!
happens: Some metal things stick, but not all of them!
why: Magnets pull on iron and steel, but not on most other things.

title: Make a Rainbow

steps: !Fill the glass with water and set it on the white paper.

Shine the flashlight through the glass from the side.
Move the light until you see colors on the paper.
happens: A little rainbow shows up on the paper!

hook: Which road is fastest for the racers in Kart Party?
steps: Roll the car down the ramp onto the floor.
Lay a towel at the bottom and roll it again.
Lay foil at the bottom and roll it again.
Which went the farthest?
happens: The car goes farthest on smooth foil and stops fast on the towel.
why: Bumpy things rub on the wheels and slow them down. That rubbing is called friction.

title: Robo's Balancing Bird
hook: Make a bird that balances on one finger, a trick from Factory Battle!
steps: Draw a bird with big wings, about as big as your hand, and cut it out.
Tape a coin under the tip of each wing.
Put the beak on your fingertip.
Let go gently!
happens: The bird balances on its beak!
why: The coins move the balance point to the beak, so it can rest there without tipping.

title: Kitten Zip Line Rescue
hook: Sparks rescues kittens! Build a zip line to send a paper kitten to safety.
steps: !Tie the string from a high chair to a low chair, nice and tight.
Bend the paper clip into a hook and poke it through the cup rim.
Put your paper kitten in the cup.
Hang the hook on the high end of the string and let go!
happens: The kitten zooms down the zip line to the rescue spot!
why: Gravity pulls the cup down the slope, and the hook slides easily on the string.

title: Super Sniffer Test
hook: Dogs have amazing noses. Test yours like a hero from Captain Woof!
steps: !Put a drop of vanilla on one cotton ball, lemon on another, and cinnamon on the third.
Put each one in a cup.
Close your eyes and sniff each cup.
Guess which smell is which!
happens: You can tell the smells apart without looking!
why: Tiny bits of smell float in the air and your nose catches them. A dog's nose catches way more!

Tap the handle end down fast!

steps: Hold each ball at the same height, like up by your shoulder.
Drop it (no throwing!).
Have your helper watch how high it bounces.
Put the balls in order from best to worst bouncer.
happens: Some balls bounce really high and some barely bounce.
why: Bouncy balls squish and spring back, but soft balls keep some of the push and do not spring back as much.

Slide the straw onto the string.
Tie the other end to another chair across the room, nice and tight.
!Blow up the balloon and pinch the end shut (do not tie it).
Tape the balloon to the straw.
Count down 3, 2, 1, and let go!
happens: The balloon rocket zooms along the string!
why: The air rushes out the back of the balloon and pushes it forward, just like a real rocket.

hook: Make colors swirl like a goo potion from Order Up! In Space!
steps: Pour milk onto the plate.
Add drops of different food coloring in the middle.
Dip the swab in dish soap.
Touch the swab to the middle of the milk.
happens: The colors burst and swirl all over!
why: Soap chases the tiny bits of fat in the milk, and the colors get swirled along.

Now fold a new sheet back and forth like a fan.
Lay the folded paper across and add coins again.
happens: The folded paper holds lots more coins!
why: Folds make the paper stiff, so it can spread out the weight.

need: a clean jar with a tight lid
steps: !Pour cream into the jar until it is half full and close the lid tight.
Shake, shake, shake! Take turns.
Keep going for about 10 minutes until it thumps.
!Open the jar and pour off the liquid.
Spread your butter on a cracker.
happens: The cream turns into a lump of butter!
why: Shaking smooshes the tiny bits of fat in the cream together until they stick.

!Slowly pour the oil on top.
Look at the layers from the side.
happens: The liquids stay in stripes instead of mixing!
why: Heavy liquids sink to the bottom and light liquids float on top.

hook: Talk to a friend across the room, like the heroes of Scare Factory sending messages!
steps: !Poke a small hole in the bottom of each cup with the pencil.
Push the string through each hole and tie it to a paper clip inside.
Walk apart until the string is tight.
Talk into one cup while your friend listens with the other!
happens: Your friend can hear you through the string!
why: Your voice makes the cup shake, and the shaking travels along the tight string to the other cup.

need: your hair or a wool sweater
steps: !Blow up the balloon and tie it.
Tear paper into tiny bits on the table.
Rub the balloon on your hair 10 times.
Hold the balloon just above the paper bits.
happens: The paper bits jump up and stick to the balloon!
why: Rubbing gives the balloon a tiny static charge that pulls light things toward it.

title: Magnet Hunt
hook: What sticks to a magnet? Hunt like a robot from Room-Cleaning Robot!
steps: Guess which things will stick.
Touch the magnet to each thing.
Make a sticks pile and a no-stick pile.
Walk around and test the fridge and doors too!
happens: Some metal things stick, but not all of them!
why: Magnets pull on iron and steel, but not on most other things.

title: Rubber Band Guitar
hook: Make a guitar and play like a rock star in Robo Jump Remix Tower!
steps: Stretch the rubber bands around the open tub.
Pluck a thin band, then a thick band.
Pull a band tighter and pluck it again.
happens: Thin and tight bands sing high, and thick and loose bands sing low.
why: Sounds come from things wiggling. Fast wiggles make high notes and slow wiggles make low notes.

title: Scaredy Pepper
hook: Make pepper run away, as fast as a hero in Robo Jump 4 Remix Studio!
steps: Sprinkle pepper all over the water.
Dip the cotton swab in dish soap.
Touch the swab to the middle of the water.
happens: The pepper zooms away to the edges!
why: Water has a stretchy skin on top, and soap breaks it, so the skin pulls the pepper away.

title: Paper Helicopter
hook: Make a spinning flyer for Boss Master Studio!
steps: !Cut a strip of paper about as long as your hand.

Drop it from up high!
happens: It spins round and round as it floats down!
why: Air pushes up on the slanted flaps, and that push makes it twirl.

title: Robo's Balloon Rocket
hook: In Car Factory things zoom fast. Let's launch a rocket across the room!

Tie the other end to another chair across the room, nice and tight.
!Blow up the balloon and pinch the end shut (do not tie it).

title: Walking Rainbow Water

why: Water creeps through the tiny spaces in the paper towel and mixes in the middle.
